svg.title: Bootstrap rows, feature thresholds and random-forest votes
svg.desc: Eight hypothetical rows have four features and class A or B. Three explicit bootstrap draws repeat some row identifiers and omit others. At the first tree root, the best thresholds on candidate features 1 and 2 give split quality 8.0 and 6.4; feature 1 at 4.5 is selected. The three one-level trees use their own samples and candidate features. A new row (5.8, 5, 0.5, 2) follows the highlighted paths and receives votes B, A, B, giving cell scores one third for A and two thirds for B.
svg.text: B Competing thresholds at Tree 1’s root
C One threshold path per tree
Cell score sₖ = votes for class k / number of trees
